items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And the old man Fontana had the symphony, and Sabatis took over, he was a violin player.

ctx.x: That's all that he had? Yeah.

And I mean all of the best musicians in the city were there. I mean they had the first class, the second class. I was second class. He didn't like the DLs, he like the professor, the Bacopa was in there, and a few other professors. And the old man Fontana had the symphony, and Sabatis took over, he was a violin player. And then, you see every Wednesday night we'd sort of play out City, Park, Nave, and we'd consolidated all the bands. And we'd have, we'd play his overtures like Wigantale, New Travica and so forth.…
Yeah, well the tape's about to run out. I think we can go on another one if you've got the time. No. Yeah, well I could block the questions.
